original.statement: Two new flags have been added to the argocd admin import command to support retrying updates on conflicts and skipping resources with specific labels.

decision.reason: [ev-a5b549ff42a5] says only that new flags were added to the `argocd admin import` CLI command, one to retry updates on conflicts and one to skip resources with specific labels. It does not name either flag, so the literal "--retry-on-conflict" has no support in the evidence. The proposed condition also uses cli-flag, which checks container arguments of the product's workloads. That does not fit an operator-run CLI subcommand, and it covers only one of the two flags. New opt-in flags leave existing use unchanged, so no environment state is exposed and the evidence supports no exposure condition.
